explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions `CoordinateSemiconvexOn`, `strictifiedQuadraticObjective` (and `Hessian`, `Point n`). A grep of the whole Mathlib tree for `CoordinateSemiconvexOn`, `SemiconvexOn` and `strictifiedQuadraticObjective` returns no matches, so no Mathlib declaration states this result; the closest related facts (e.g. `ConvexOn.coordinateSemiconvexOn_zero`) are themselves local to the library. The proof only re-derives an explicit constant (the sum of absolute matrix entries) so that the entrywise-bound version of the theorem applies.
